latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the ai-augmentation-not-automation skill, advocating for AI augmentation over pure automation.
- Provides leaders with frameworks for job redesign, creativity-driven AI deployment, and long-term workforce investment.
- Draws on the centaur model and real-world case studies to demonstrate the benefits of human-AI collaboration.
- Highlights risks of automation including skills atrophy, workforce polarization, and diminished organizational capability.
- Offers practical guidance for designing roles and processes that pair human creativity with AI capabilities for superior outcomes.
